Konke okusemaZulwini naseMhlabeni kudumisa u Allah, futhi nguye uSomandla Okhaliphile.
Nina enikholwayo kungani nikhuluma eningakwenzi na?
Kumuthukuthelisa kakhulu u Allah uma nikhuluma eningakwenzi.
U Allah uthanda labo uma belwa endleleni Yakhe bame ngemigqa kube ngathi bayisakhiwo esihlangene.
Khumbula lapho uMusa ethi kubantu bakhe: “Bantu bami, kungani ningihlukumeza nibe nazi kahle ukuthi ngiyiSithunywa sika Allah kini”. Kwathi uma bephambuka, u Allah waphambukisa izinhliziyo zabo.

Khumbula futhi lapho u-Isa ka Mariyamu ethi: “Sizwe sika Isirayeli, ngempela ngiyiSithunywa sika Allah kini, ngifakazela lokho okufike phambi kwami futhi ngethula izindaba ezinhle ngeSithunywa esiza emuva kwami ogama laso ngu Ahmadi”. Kwathi lapho ebalethela izibonakaliso bathi: “Lokhu ubuthakathi uqobo”.
Ingabe ubani ophambuke ukundlula lowo oqamba amanga ngo Allah ebe emenyelwa ku Isilamu; u Allah akabahlengi abantu abaphambukile.
Bafuna ukushabalalisa inkanyiso ka Allah; kepha u Allah uyoyiphelelisa inkanyiso yaKhe nakuba abangakholwa bengathandi.
Phela nguyena owathumela iSithunywa Sakhe nenkolo yeqiniso ukuze ayiphakamise phezu kwazo zonke izinkolo nakuba amaMushiriki engathandi.
Nina enikholwayo! Nginganikhombisa uhwebo oluzoniphephisa esijezisweni esibuhlungu na?
Kholwani ku Allah neSithunywa Sakhe futhi nilwe endleleni Yakhe ngengcebo yenu kanye nani uqobo; lokho yikona okuhle kini uma nje benazi.
Uyonithethelela izimpambuko zenu aningenise eziVandeni okugeleza imifula ngaphansi kwazo, kanye nezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle eziVandeni zenhlalo engunomphela; lokho iyona kanye impumelelo enkulu.
Kokunye enikulangazelelayo, usizo luka Allah nokunqoba okuseduze; yethulake izindaba ezinhle kwabakholwayo.

Nina enikholwayo, yibani abasizi baka Allah, njenga mhla u-Isa ka Mariyamu ethi kumaHawariyina: “Obani abazoba abasizi bami ku Allah na?” Athi amaHawariyina: “Yithina abasizi baka Allah!”. Kwaba khona labo abakholwayo esizweni sika Isirayeli futhi kwaba khona labo abangakholwa; sabe-ke sesilekelela labo abakholwayo ezitheni zabo baba ngabanqobayo.
